comment: M07 golden-slice faction read. A joined player waits in the tunnel while posed views frame the curfew patrol, the only guards placed before activation (later groups, the gate Turret and every Ranged Sweeper spawn when their encounter wakes; client/qa/m07_declared_goods.json reaches them through combat). Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m07_declared_goods.json. Check black armour, red visors, armbands and optics against the frontage, awnings and dark shutters at street distance; art review, not combat evidence.
